formulas.formula: Two incomes, one plan: share the bills fairly and keep your own money your own.
1. Setup: your names, each person's monthly take-home pay, and how to split shared costs: by income, 50/50 or a custom %.
2. Ours: every shared bill and expense. The sheet shows each person's share and how much each moves to the joint account monthly.
3. Yours & Mine: each person's own bills and fun money, and what's left after everything.
4. Spending: log what you spend, who paid (a name or Joint) and who it was for (Ours or a name).
5. Monthly: shared budget vs spending, and the settle-up: who owes whom when one of you paid for something shared or for the other.
6. Dashboard: who pays what, this month's settle-up, and where the shared money goes.
Each person pays the same % of their income. Earn 60% of the total? Pay 60% of shared costs.
Move your share to the joint account each month and pay shared bills from there.
Paid for groceries with your own card? Log it as paid by you, for Ours. The other person owes you their share.
Paid By and For must match the names on Setup (or say Joint / Ours). Anything else shows a ?.
Clear the white cells on Ours, Yours & Mine and Spending, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: all square, or under budget.
Yellow: money owed, or close to the limit.
Red: over budget, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase! Teamwork makes the dream work.
